The issuer displays an exceptionally strong balance sheet with substantial liquidity (current ratio of 3.85x) and very low leverage (total debt/liabilities of 174M against equity of 635M and assets of 809M), alongside solid operating profitability (EBIT margin of 14.36%). While the net income is elevated by non-operating items and the negative retained earnings point to past historical losses or capital restructuring, the current solvency, capital structure, and strong asset coverage comfortably support a solid investment-grade profile.

DECISION: A-
